items.what: set_crs must also set the CRS on the spatial_partitions GeoSeries (so it becomes non-None and matches the new CRS), not just preserve it
items.quote:
assert new.spatial_partitions.crs is not None
assert CRS.from_user_input(new.spatial_partitions.crs) == CRS.from_user_input(new_crs)

reason: The instruction only asks to preserve spatial_partitions on set_crs; the hidden tests additionally require the spatial_partitions' own crs attribute to be updated to the new CRS, which the instruction never states (it only shows preservation of geometry values).
